The '''[[Eredivisie|Netherlands Football League Championship]] 1892–1893''' was contested by five teams from the cities [[Amsterdam]], [[The Hague]], [[Haarlem]] and [[Rotterdam]]. The teams participated in the competition that would later be called ''Eerste Klasse West''. But since the western football district of the Netherlands was the only one to have a competition at the time, it could be regarded as a national championship. [[Koninklijke HFC]] won the championship, however this championship was not official, since the teams had not played an equal number of matches.
